name: noaa-spaceweather-mcp-server
description: Query NOAA SWPC space weather: geomagnetic storm scales, Kp index, aurora forecasts, solar wind, solar activity, and alerts via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: NOAA SWPC space weather: storm scales, Kp index, aurora forecasts, solar wind, activity, alerts.
interface.longDescription: Read-only access to the NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center (SWPC). Six tools cover the operational space-weather picture: get_conditions for a current R/S/G storm-scale snapshot with the latest Kp and a plain-language summary, get_kp_index for observed and forecast planetary K-index, get_aurora_forecast for coordinate-based aurora visibility, get_solar_wind for real-time plasma and magnetic-field data from the active L1 spacecraft (including the southward Bz that drives geomagnetic storms), get_solar_activity for X-ray flux and recent flare events, and get_alerts for active SWPC watches, warnings, and advisories. All SWPC feeds are public and keyless; the server runs over STDIO or Streamable HTTP.
